gate_decision_rationale: All structural pre-conditions pass: 100% test pass rate (27/27), 0 manifest duplicates, 100% geometry validity (7,164/7,164), daily mosaicking and SCL masking verified, atomic checkpointing implemented, and Earth Engine authenticated. The non-blocking risks are: (1) realistic runtime is ~18 to 22 hours across 7,164 farms, requiring chunked resumable execution (e.g. 500 farms per chunk), and (2) expected cloud-related failure rate of ~1.5-2.5% on monsoon short-duration farms.

test_suite_status.report_name: Test Suite Execution and Coverage Status

handling_of_10_failed_farms.scientific_justification: All 10 farms failed due to 100% persistent cloud and cloud-shadow coverage over extremely short Kharif duration windows (1 to 4 days during peak monsoon). Because the historical Sentinel-2 archive for those specific coordinate-date bounding boxes has zero cloud-free observations, retrying against Earth Engine will return identical null results. Retrying would waste quota without generating valid observations.

production_extractor_audit.mosaicking_strategy: mosaic_same_date_scenes groups multi-tile acquisitions by UTC date and composites them before temporal median
production_extractor_audit.cloud_shadow_masking: SCL Scene Classification Layer masking values 3 (shadow), 8 (med prob), 9 (high prob), 10 (cirrus), 11 (snow/ice)
production_extractor_audit.nan_preservation: Unmasked missing observations strictly preserve NaN; no zero replacement
production_extractor_audit.atomic_writes: Implemented via temporary file + atomic rename (.tmp -> .csv)
production_extractor_audit.exponential_backoff: 3 retries with jittered exponential backoff on HTTP 429, 503, or rate limit
production_extractor_audit.checkpoint_recovery: Deduplicated resume from existing checkpoint files without data loss

resource_and_runtime_estimates.concurrency_scaling_option: With 8 workers, runtime reduces to ~10.5 to 12.5 hours, but slightly increases GEE RPC concurrency
resource_and_runtime_estimates.chunk_breakdown: 14 chunks of 500 farms + 1 chunk of 164 farms
resource_and_runtime_estimates.gee_quota_risk: LOW with 4-6 workers (within 100-200 concurrent interactive quota limit)
resource_and_runtime_estimates.disk_storage_estimate: Raw bands CSV: ~3.5 MB, Features CSV: ~12 MB, Checkpoints/Logs: ~30 MB (Total < 50 MB)
resource_and_runtime_estimates.expected_yield: Estimated ~7,000 to 7,050 successful farms (~97.5% success rate; ~120-160 cloud failures on short Kharif windows)

safeguards: Phase 6C and Phase 6D files are read-only and preserved untouched.
Each chunk writes to its own isolated checkpoint file before final concatenation.
Atomic disk writing prevents corruption from sudden disconnection or process termination.
Model training is strictly decoupled and barred from running between extraction chunks.
